name: select_idea
description: Select an idea the user asked for by its exact ID from the latest Framewise snapshot.

ideaId.description: Exact ID of the requested idea from the current snapshot.

name: set_coaching_paused
description: Pause or resume coaching when the user explicitly asks. A pause cancels a countdown.

paused.description: True to pause coaching, false to resume it.

name: repeat_instruction
description: Get the latest grounded coaching correction when the user asks to hear it again or asks what the last instruction meant.

name: request_capture
description: Request the existing app shutter after an explicit request to take a photo. Wait for the actual result.
